recognize_zh: 成群的中型母細胞，胞質深藍色並充滿圓形清楚的空泡（cytoplasmic vacuoles），染色質細緻，這是 Burkitt 淋巴瘤/白血病（舊稱 L3）的典型外觀。
features: Sheets and clusters of medium-sized, monomorphic blasts
Round nuclei with finely clumped chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles
Many cells with vacuoles overlying the nucleus as well as cytoplasm
Scattered bare/smudged nuclei in the background
describe_en: The smear is replaced by clusters and sheets of monomorphic medium-sized blasts. The cells have round nuclei with finely clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous discrete, punched-out vacuoles. Normal hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with Burkitt leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation requires a mature B-cell phenotype (CD10+, BCL2-negative, surface light chain restricted, Ki-67 ~100%) and MYC rearrangement.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts have scant, less basophilic cytoplasm without prominent vacuolation, are TdT positive and lack surface light chain.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: These are more pleomorphic with larger nuclei and prominent nucleoli and typically express BCL2; FISH for MYC/BCL2/BCL6 separates them.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic leukemia with vacuolated cytoplasm
ddx.vs: Monoblasts have gray-blue, more abundant cytoplasm, folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase positive rather than B-cell marker positive.
